name: summarize_by_category
author: hprebar
title: Summarize items by category or property
description: Counts model items grouped by class (default) or by the value of one property given as 'Category.Property' (e.g. Item.Type, Element.Level). Walks at most maxItems items (default 200000) and returns up to maxGroups groups sorted by count. Read-only.

groupBy.description: 'Category.Property' display names to group by, e.g. Item.Type; empty groups by item class

maxItems.description: Items visited before the walk stops (the answer says whether it was complete)
